label: s3-dispatch-cases-v1
status: SIMULATED public fixture (S3-01 phases 1-3, I-sim-dispatch-cases; phase 2 adds the persisted dispatch-3 result per case; phase 3 adds the ordinary necessary-interval case). Not field evidence. Fault-fixture labels are manifest annotations, not central attestation.
replayability: Evidence, batch, run and revision IDs are per run: each run recreates the database, registers a new gateway and new Foundation/binding revisions, and batch IDs digest those. The fixture is replayable by procedure + seeds + verify (same cases, counts, values and claim checks), not byte-for-byte. Fault-fixture templates are chosen by minimum (source_time, sequence), so their values are stable across runs.
